description: Call this tool to write a one-page cover letter .docx from the stored profile and return the path, word count and bracketed prompts. Nothing from the posting is restated as yours. Free: 3 a month.

highlights.description: Points to lead with. Each is checked against the profile; anything not found there is returned as a bracketed prompt, not printed as fact.

job_description.description: Paste the posting. Used only to pick which of your own skills to lead with; no figure from the posting is ever restated as yours.

out_path.description: Where to write the .docx. Defaults to <data dir>/documents/<company>-<role>-cover-letter.docx, numbered -2, -3, ... if that exists.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file at out_path. Default false: the call fails and nothing is written.

name: cover_letter_create
title: Write a cover letter .docx
